rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Referent resolution under a sequential deck read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Closest: chunk 2 "When agents analyse wider...", slide line "So analysis is getting cheap, the way building did." (raw include line 5): "building" is named in chunk 1 header (raw line 3) and "the bet" in chunk 4 (raw line 9) is a bolded loop item in chunk 1; both are earlier-slide named terms, not violations. Chunk 3 "we tried building" resolves to the byline on the same slide (Antti Tevanlinna). Harm (reader cannot resolve a referent) absent.

No chunk points at another file by position; closest is chunk 4 "the bet" (raw line 9), a term earned in chunk 1 of this same file. grep -n -i -E "opening lecture|last module|earlier lecture" on expanded view -> 0.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Every backward reference points at a beat that exists.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Closest: chunk 3 "Also, right after we had it, the ecosystem shifted" (raw line 7) is the essay's own event, narrated with its source, not a beat the room did. No "the X you did/saw/caught" anywhere in the five chunks.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Live-demo beats survive a text read.
rules_evaluated.na_reason: no guess-before-reveal or live-demo beat in any chunk

rules_evaluated.evidence: Smallest chunk is chunk 2 (raw line 5): three sentences plus the question, self-carrying claim "analysis is getting cheap, the way building did". Every chunk has its own claim; none is a wait-state.

Closest: chunk 2 header is a question (raw line 5) and body states the premise then asks it again ("What does your team bring that the analysis does not?"); header and body agree. Chunk 3 header "We built a tool that worked. It was used just a bit." is true of the body. Chunk 1 header matches the loop-then-decisions body.

No "Not X. Not Y. Z." run; chunk 5 "Discovery is not a research team handing a report..." is a single negation, not a pair. Closest anaphora: chunk 2 "every interview transcript, every support ticket" is a pair, not a triple. Chunk 1 "choosing..., hearing..., placing..., reading..." is one verbed list with concrete objects. No self-grading superlative, no number+retraction, no abstraction-noun stack, verb triplet in chunk 2 ("sort them, find the patterns and draft the summary") has three concrete legs.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Internal dialect never lands on a slide.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Closest: chunk 1 "Slice", "Bet", "Signal" bolded loop terms (raw line 3). These are the product-practice vocabulary a PO/designer/lead in the room uses (outcome-driven product work), defined on the slide itself; not repo dialect. grep -n -i -E "compendium|forcing function|firing|writing surface|mood|beat" on the expanded body (above maintainer cut) -> 0 hits in student text.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Emphasis budget — bold is for handles, and go very lightly.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Closest: chunk 1 carries five bolded labels (**Outcome:**, **Opportunities:**, **Bet:**, **Slice:**, **Signal:**), each one word, none a whole sentence. They are the loop's named item names, i.e. the checklist-item-name case the rule lists as a handle, on a definition slide whose job is the five names. Handle cap held; chunks 2-5 carry zero bold (grep -c "\*\*" on those slide bodies -> 0).

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Heading grammar is the mood switch, and it is load-bearing.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Closest: chunk 2 header is a question, not a claim (raw line 5). Lecture headings should be claims, but the rule binds law/consolidation slides and "not every header owes a claim"; this slide is a provocation whose teaching is the open question (the maintainer block says the stance question is planted), so a claim header would give the answer away. Other four headers are claims (e.g. "Building got cheap, deciding didn't"). Harm (a label masquerading as a declaration) absent.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: A bullet earns its slot or dies — three classes that read as rigour and carry nothing.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Closest: chunk 3 last line "With agents, more of what your team builds will work; whether a customer needs it is still decided before the build." (raw line 7) could read as doctrine restatement of chunk 1 "Every other step is a decision". It stays: it is the bridge that applies the essay to the team, adding the working-versus-needed distinction chunk 1 does not state. Chunk 2 "Keep your own answer to that question." is an instruction the room acts on, not a koan restating the header. No design-commentary bullets.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: A retitled slide re-earns its bullets against the new header.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Judge move on each slide: cover body, read header, uncover. Chunk 2 header "When agents analyse wider..." promises the analysis-is-cheap premise and the open question, and the body is exactly that; no inherited bullets from an older header. Slides are a fresh 2026-10-07 squint build; no provenance note of the "(from <old-file>, header his)" shape in the lecture maintainer block.
